prompt:
Research the following and cite real, verifiable sources:

Find real, currently-maintained open-source GitHub repositories implementing arbitrage bots for Polymarket or other prediction markets. Include actual repo names/URLs and any real reported performance figures you can find.

If you're not sure about something, just say so.
response:
Based on real GitHub repositories surfaced through current search results, here are verifiable open-source projects that focus on Polymarket or prediction-market arbitrage bots.

1. [taetaehoho/poly-kalshi-arb](https://github.com/taetaehoho/poly-kalshi-arb)  
   - A **Rust** arbitrage system for cross-platform prediction-market trading between **Kalshi** and **Polymarket**.
   - Features include:
     - Kalshi REST/WebSocket client
     - Polymarket REST/WebSocket client
     - lock-free orderbook cache
     - SIMD-based arbitrage detection
     - concurrent order execution
     - position and P&L tracking
     - circuit breaker
   - It explicitly factors **Kalshi fees** into arbitrage detection:
     - `ceil(0.07 × contracts × price × (1-price))`
   - Notes Polymarket as having **zero trading fees**.
   - Defines four arbitrage types:
     - `poly_yes_kalshi_no`
     - `kalshi_yes_poly_no`
     - `poly_same_market`
     - `kalshi_same_market`
   - **Performance figures:** I did **not** find verified profit or win-rate figures in the repo excerpt. It does mention benchmarks can be run with `cargo bench`, but no actual results were provided in the search snippet.

2. [ImMike/polymarket-arbitrage](https://github.com/ImMike/polymarket-arbitrage)  
   - A **Python** bot for **Polymarket + Kalshi arbitrage**.
   - Watches **10,000+ markets** across and between platforms.
   - Features include:
     - cross-platform arbitrage
     - bundle arbitrage detection
     - market making
     - risk management
     - live dashboard
     - dual data modes
     - fee accounting
     - market matching using text similarity
   - Connects to Polymarket’s **Gamma API** for market discovery and fetches real order books from the **CLOB API**.
   - Reported repo stats in the search result:
     - **232 stars**
     - **111 forks**
   - **Reported performance figures:**
     - In **simulation mode**, it reports **99.6% win rate** and **$573 profit**.
     - Importantly, the repo also says:  
       > “Real prediction markets are highly efficient. Arbitrage opportunities are rare and fleeting.”
     - That means the strong performance figure appears to be from **simulation**, not verified live trading results.

3. [Longbridges/polymarket-kalshi-arbitrage-bot](https://github.com/Longbridges/polymarket-kalshi-arbitrage-bot)  
   - A **TypeScript** bot for monitoring short-duration prediction markets across **Polymarket** and **Kalshi**.
   - Designed especially for **15-minute markets**.
   - Features include:
     - pulls Polymarket UP/DOWN token pricing from the CLOB
     - pulls Kalshi YES/NO pricing and market status
     - configurable trade evaluation window
     - emits structured arbitrage signals via `/status`
     - can place Polymarket buy orders with `@polymarket/clob-client`
     - order cooldowns to reduce duplicate executions
     - Express-based deployment
   - Example strategy rule given in repo:
     - Kalshi YES between **93 and 96 cents**
     - Polymarket UP at least **10 cents cheaper**
     - emits `buy_polymarket`
   - Repo metadata from search:
     - **81 stars**
     - **292 forks**
     - created **2026-05-11**
   - **Performance figures:** I did **not** find verified live profit, ROI, or win-rate claims in the search result.

4. [realfishsam/prediction-market-arbitrage-bot](https://github.com/realfishsam/prediction-market-arbitrage-bot)  
   - Described as an **educational** bot that detects and executes synthetic arbitrage strategies between **Polymarket** and **Kalshi**.
   - Built with **pmxt**, described in the repo summary as a unified API for prediction markets.
   - **Performance figures:** I did **not** find any real performance metrics in the surfaced snippet.

5. [Pushpenderrathore/karb](https://github.com/Pushpenderrathore/karb)  
   - A **Polymarket arbitrage bot** focused on automated detection and execution of “risk-free” arbitrage opportunities.
   - Features from the repo snippet:
     - real-time WebSocket price monitoring
     - **6 parallel connections**
     - supports up to **1500 markets**
     - low-latency async order execution
     - native async HTTP with HTTP/2
     - parallel order signing
     - order monitoring with **10-second timeout** and auto-cancellation
     - market filtering by liquidity (**$10k+ default**) and resolution date (**7 days default**)
     - web dashboard
     - Slack notifications
     - SOCKS5 proxy support
   - Includes setup with Polymarket CLOB credentials and USDC approval scripts.
   - **Performance figures:** No verified profitability or live-trading performance numbers were present in the search result.

## Summary

### Most concrete “currently visible” repos from the search
- [taetaehoho/poly-kalshi-arb](https://github.com/taetaehoho/poly-kalshi-arb)
- [ImMike/polymarket-arbitrage](https://github.com/ImMike/polymarket-arbitrage)
- [Longbridges/polymarket-kalshi-arbitrage-bot](https://github.com/Longbridges/polymarket-kalshi-arbitrage-bot)
- [realfishsam/prediction-market-arbitrage-bot](https://github.com/realfishsam/prediction-market-arbitrage-bot)
- [Pushpenderrathore/karb](https://github.com/Pushpenderrathore/karb)

### Performance evidence found
The only explicit performance claim I found was from  
[ImMike/polymarket-arbitrage](https://github.com/ImMike/polymarket-arbitrage):
- **99.6% win rate**
- **$573 profit**
- but this was specifically in **simulation mode**, not confirmed live trading.

### Important caveat
I do **not** see verifiable, independently audited live-trading P&L results in the surfaced material for any of these repos. The repos themselves are real and inspectable, but most do not provide hard evidence of sustained profitable performance.
